title: Character-Specific Move Callouts, Heavy-Weapon Attack Speed & HUD Passive Status Widget
author: Antigravity Engineer
objective: Replace hardcoded Ngô Nhất Nghị attack and counter floating callouts with active character-specific move names from CharacterRegistry, slow down attack animations for heavy-weapon heroes (Triệu Đình An and Phó Đặng Hoàng Anh), and add a persistent HUD Passive & Stance [W+U] widget under the HP/Energy bars so players can track stacks and passive states clearly without relying on transient floating text.
requestedBehavior: Resolve active character move labels via CharacterRegistry.getSkillMoveLabel(player, moveId, fallback) in playerInput.js and combat.js so each of the 9 heroes uses their own move/counter names (and Vovinam skin falls back to nghi).
Remove transient per-hit stack counting floating texts (Sao Kê 1/3..2/3 and Hàn Khí 1/4..3/4) while displaying live stack pips on the HUD Passive Widget under the HP/Energy bars.
Apply attackDurationMul (1.22 for dinhan, 1.26 for hoanganh) in PlayerBase.setCharacter and PlayerBase.startAttack when not wearing the Vovinam skin.
Render #hud-passive-widget and #badge-stance-wu in index.html / css/hud.css and synchronize them via CharacterRegistry.getPassiveHudStatus and UIManager.updateSkillCooldowns.

Display active debuffs and stacks (Bleed, Stun, Freeze, Blind, Slow, Guard Break, Exhaust, Stale, Sao Ke, Han Khi, Boss Weak) on Player HUD (#hud-debuffs-bar), Boss HUD (#boss-debuffs-bar), and entity overhead badges (animationRenderBase.js).

authorizedRemovals: Per-hit stack count floating text spam in tiendang.js and giangmanh.js replaced by #hud-passive-widget
Hardcoded Ngô Nhất Nghị floating strings in playerInput.js and combat.js replaced by dynamic getSkillMoveLabel

acceptanceCriteria: All 9 characters display their own uppercut/wk/elbow_strike/kick_sweep/counter move names instead of Ngô Nhất Nghị text
dinhan (1.22x) and hoanganh (1.26x) have slower attack stateDuration in PlayerBase.startAttack
#hud-passive-widget and #badge-stance-wu render cleanly under the HP/Energy bars and update dynamically per character
25/25 regression test suites pass and headless browser smoke test exits cleanly with 0 console errors
